description: This PHP script handles exporting test cases and test suites in the TestLink open source test management system. It manages export options, generates XML content, and initiates file downloads based on user input and project structure.

classes.name: tree
classes.description: Class managing hierarchical project structure and node information.

classes.name: testcase
classes.description: Class for handling individual test case data and export.

classes.name: testsuite
classes.description: Class for handling test suite data and export.

classes.name: TLSmarty
classes.description: Template rendering class for Smarty templates.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and sanitizes request arguments, setting up export options and project context.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Creates and configures the GUI object for export interface, including cancel action JavaScript.
